title: eval-harness: add CI prompt-regression gating and eval metrics integration
author: Ava Patel
release_notes: Adds a CI-level prompt regression gate that runs a small eval suite on PRs and fails CI if quality drops exceed configured thresholds; integrates eval metrics artifacts into PR UI.
description: Context: We need deterministic CI-level checks to detect prompt-set regressions before they reach main. This PR wires the eval-harness into GitHub Actions and adds a quality gating step that compares current PR eval metrics against a pinned baseline. Motivation: prevent regressions in generation quality introduced by prompt or model changes and give engineers fast, actionable feedback in CI. What this PR does: adds .github/workflows/eval-harness-ci.yml which runs a targeted eval job for changed prompt-sets, adds eval-harness/ci/run_eval.py that orchestrates runs and emits a machine-readable metrics artifact, implements eval-harness/checks/prompt_regression.py which computes delta metrics and applies configurable thresholds, stores baselines under eval-harness/baselines/*, adds a docs page docs/ci/eval-gating.md describing workflow and opt-outs, and includes unit tests under tests/eval/test_prompt_regression.py. Configuration: thresholds are configurable via .github/eval-gating.yml and default to a 1.5% absolute drop on top-1 exact-match or 2% relative drop on BLEU-like quality metrics; PRs can opt out by adding label ci-skip-eval or by using the bypass token for emergency merges. CI behavior: failure in the quality gate marks the check as failed and prevents merges unless a maintainer overrides. Artifacts: full metrics json and a short summary are uploaded to the PR as artifacts and a comment is posted with a digest and links to detailed results. Checklist: [x] implement GH Action workflow [x] produce stable metrics artifact [x] implement gating logic [x] add docs and opt-out [x] tests and unit coverage [x] e2e smoke run on a staging branch Related: ENG-1234 details the rollout plan and required baseline runs. Notes: this PR intentionally keeps eval scope small for CI (fast prompt subsets) and delegates larger nightly runs to the existing eval cron. No model weights are included.
